limitations: The deduction from the cited theorems is pending an independent Skeptic check; until then the status stays COMPUTATIONALLY SUPPORTED (1314 hard relations up to n = 12 / 7).
novelty_basis: Derived by the Historian from Gray-Steinberg 2026 Thm 8.1 (no common border => Hochschild cohomological dimension <= 2 => gl.dim K<A>/(u-v) <= 2 => u - v strongly free, Anick 1982 => Hilbert series 1/(1-qx+x^k)); for different first or last letters also Albenque-Nadeau 2009 Cor. 3 + Adjan's cancellativity. All 527 relations left open by EXP-C01-07 are in this case.
statement:
If u != v have length k over a q-letter alphabet and no word is a border of both, the class counts of length-n
words modulo u = v have generating function 1/(1 - q x + x^k).
title: Common-border formula when u and v share no border (c = 1) - consequence of published results
